tax.note: General taxpayers 13%, 9% and 6%; small-scale taxpayers 3%. One source reports a temporary 1% small-scale rate to the end of 2027 that was not confirmed against the State Taxation Administration, so it is not offered. The 18-character unified social credit code pattern is from general knowledge and was not checked in a source. An ordinary receipt is not a fapiao, the official tax invoice.
